findings.statement: Iñaki Urdangarin Liebaert is a retired Spanish handball player and former husband of Infanta Cristina.
He was involved in the Nóos case through his nonprofit foundation, the Nóos Institute.
According to the Wikipedia article on the Nóos affair, a Spanish court convicted Iñaki Urdangarin on 17 February 2017 and sentenced him to six years and three months in prison.
According to the Wikipedia article on Iñaki Urdangarin, his sentence was later reduced on appeal by the Supreme Court on 12 June 2018 to five years and ten months.

conflict_notes: The Wikipedia article on Iñaki Urdangarin states that his sentence was reduced to five years and ten months on 12 June 2018, whereas the Wikipedia article on the Nóos affair states that he was convicted on 17 February 2017 and sentenced to six years and three months. This reflects a conflict between the initial conviction and the final appellate sentence, but without external sources it is unclear which represents the final legal outcome.
